senses.gloss: m. (v. סְגֵי I; cmp. סוּגְיָינָא; for the apocopate form cmp. רֵעַ a. רֵעֶה) growth, sproutings, esp. luxuriant growth (in good or bad sense).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:2">Tosef. Ukts. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3">T’bul Yom III</cite>) <he>הס׳ של אשכלות</he> the foliage covering the clusters of grapes, <he>של רצפות</he> the cobweb-like covering of fruits; <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:2">Ukts. I, 2</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="O00560"><he>סִיגִּים</he></cite>, <he>סִגִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:5">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:13">Deut. VII, 13</cite>) <he>מה פרי אדמתך ס׳ וכ׳</he> as the fruit of thy ground will be of luxuriant growth, so will be the fruit of thy womb (strong people).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:20">Num. R. s. 16</cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 12 (ref. to Is.XVII, 11) <he>ביום שאמר …</he> (<cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite>) <he>עשיתם ס׳</he> on the day that he intended to plant you in the land, you became a luxuriant growth (degenerated); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite>.—[Sifra Sh’mini, ch. VII, Par. 6, v. <cite ref="O00244"><he>סוּג</he> II</cite> .].
